Full summary: Task 6 (/api/health-report) implemented via subagent: 7 new tests green, suite 1152 pass, tsc clean, 5k fixture cold 91ms / cached 0.4ms. Review subagent running; commit follows approval. Phase 1 nearly complete.
Decisions: Accepted implementer judgment: health-report staleness scores decisions only — the JSON contract has no stale-blackboard slot and the spec's health card is 'stale decision candidates'; blackboard staleness remains twining_housekeeping's job.; Accepted implementer judgment: health-report composes scoreItem/buildProbes over decision INDEX entries instead of calling auditStaleness() — avoids O(all-decisions) full-file reads (91ms vs multi-second at 5k), at the cost of the branch_gone signal which needs provenance not present on the index. The endpoint is a fast candidates preview, not an exhaustive audit; twining_housekeeping keeps full fidelity.
